DRAFT sample. Before marrying an NRI, check the same facts you would check for anyone, plus their status abroad. That means visa or residency status, current job, and marital status in the country where they live.

## What should you check abroad?

Ask for proof of the right to live and work in that country. Ask for a recent payslip and an address you can confirm with relatives or friends there.

:::callout{type="warning"}
Be careful if the wedding is rushed, kept quiet, or planned to happen only in a registry office.
:::

## Where can you get official help?

The Ministry of External Affairs has a page on [marital issues with overseas Indians](https://www.mea.gov.in/miinmoi). Indian missions abroad can also guide you.

Read the [verification guide sample](/marriage-verification-basics), the sample on [asking for documents](/for-parents/draft-how-to-ask-for-documents), and the [red flags sample](/matrimonial-fraud/draft-red-flags-in-a-biodata).
